method: Read in a browser as a visitor: searched each stop’s place names, opened each location, and recorded its official name, location ID and pin position (the map centres on the pin). Lot positions came the same way. No shuttle stops, shuttle category, block numbers or step-free route information appear on the map. Only names, IDs, positions and links are kept here: the map’s descriptions and photos are not copied (Concept3D end-user terms §4.2; the photos carry no reuse licence), so riders get an “Official campus photos” link instead.

barone-traffic-circle.note: The map marks the building and a 360° view point beside it, not a shuttle stop. The suggested point on the Loyola Drive loop is 85 m from the building pin.

walsh-lot-crosswalk.note: No lot is called “Walsh Lot” on the map. G3 is the lot it shows west of the Walsh Athletic Center (60 m from the suggestion); the J lots are east of the building, 140–185 m away.

dolan-campus-circle.note: Dolan Hall, Dolan Commons and Dolan House are 48–75 m from the suggested loop; the map lists H1 and H2 under “Dolan Campus Parking”. No shuttle stop is marked.

library-meditz-crosswalk.note: The suggested crosswalk lies between the library (77 m) and Meditz Hall (89 m) pins. No shuttle stop is marked.
